Both work, but between the two I prefer the instant one. Typing "renovation" and having the list narrow right away as I go feels lighter — I see whether I'm on the right track immediately and can adjust a letter or two without stopping. Having to type it out and then press "Search" adds a little step that, honestly, I'd rather not have for everyday rummaging.

So my pick is the live, narrows-as-you-type version. That's the one that matches how I'd actually poke around looking for a link.
